name: tempo-node-manager
description: Tempo Node Manager - Self-hosted node management system

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd agent && yarn dev" "cd web && yarn dev"
scripts.build: cd agent && yarn build && cd ../web && yarn build
scripts.clean: cd agent && yarn clean && cd ../web && yarn clean
scripts.release: VERSION=$(grep '"version"' package.json | head -1 | sed 's/.*"version": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/') && TAG="node-manager-v$VERSION" && (git tag -d $TAG 2>/dev/null; git push origin :refs/tags/$TAG 2>/dev/null; true) && git tag -a $TAG -m "Tempo Node Manager v$VERSION" && git push origin $TAG && echo "Released $TAG"
